description.value:
You drain the vital energy from a foe, siphoning their life force and preventing them from recovering while bolstering your own resilience.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-reave] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[void]] damage and cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[void]] damage, cannot regain HP for 1 round, and you regain @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[HP]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[void]] damage, you regain @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[HP]] damage, and the target cannot regain HP for 1 minute (or until the end of combat).

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
